keep in mind each specific slot can only have one of 4 specific mainstats, and each stat only shows up on 3 out of the 6 slots
so you can't, for instance, have 6 critdamage mainstat pieces because critdamage only shows up in 3 slots
the covenant tab has a list of which stats can show up on which pieces and then you can check the character lists to see the sets various awakeners use and what stat priorities they prefer

it depends a lot on the character, usually it's easier to make up for a lack of critrate than it is to make up for a lack of critdamage, but there are a few characters that struggle quite a bit with critrate who will prefer stacking it (usually specifically in dtide due to less options for teamcomps/wheels)
